capture.note: The SEC filing is primary evidence, but this artifact preserves extracted line references rather than claiming a byte-complete raw HTML receipt. It is not eligible as a point-in-time market feature.

advance_funding.subscribers: Certain Advance Funding Subscribers, including SBI Stockholders
advance_funding.sbi_specific_cash_allocation_note: The cited filing identifies SBI as an Advance Funding Subscriber and describes its ownership cap, but does not separately quantify SBI's dollar allocation in these sections.

cash_subscriptions.implied_cash_deployed_per_xrp_note: Derived from $214.05M / 84,365,876 XRP. Not an exchange execution VWAP, not an independently verified trade-level average, and not a current market price.

closing_cash_proceeds.reconciliation_note: Advance Funding cash plus Delayed Funding cash is approximately the reported $224.6M private-placement cash. The $214.1M cash purchase amount is a component of this private-placement cash, not an additional amount to add to the $272.6M.

convertible_senior_pik_notes.stated_use: General corporate purposes, including acquisition of XRP and other XRP ecosystem activities
convertible_senior_pik_notes.classification: debt financing; not proof of XRP purchase
convertible_senior_pik_notes.lender_or_trustee: NH Investment & Securities Co., as trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3

ripple_related_party_credit_facility.classification: related-party borrowing; not equity and not proof of XRP purchase
ripple_related_party_credit_facility.repayment_terms: Amounts drawn were repayable within five business days after closing or earlier on five business days' notice of demand by Ripple.

holdings_reconciliation.reconciliation_status: Arithmetic sum is consistent with the filing's approximate 473M XRP holdings. It is not a wallet-level custody reconciliation and does not establish current holdings.

contingent_warrant_capital.security_underlying: Pubco Class A common stock, not XRP
contingent_warrant_capital.cash_exercise_conditions: Cash exercise requires an effective and current registration statement and prospectus for the warrant shares. If registration is not effective within 90 days after closing, cashless exercise may be available only if an exemption applies; otherwise holders cannot exercise cashlessly. Management may also require cashless exercise upon a qualifying redemption.
contingent_warrant_capital.exercise_proceeds_recipient: Pubco directly, not the Trust Account.
contingent_warrant_capital.classification: Potential corporate equity proceeds, not XRP purchase capital; not included in the reported $272.6M gross closing cash proceeds or the $214.1M cash-funded XRP acquisition.
contingent_warrant_capital.interpretation: The maximum is a mathematical gross ceiling assuming every remaining public and private warrant is exercised for cash at $11.50. It is not actual capital received, is subject to registration and exercise conditions, and relates to Pubco stock rather than XRP.

institutional_relationships.sbi_definition: The filing explicitly defines 'SBI' as SBI Holdings, Inc.

sbi_ownership_limitation.treatment_above_cap: Balance of subscribed shares issued as Pubco Class C Common Stock.
sbi_ownership_limitation.effect_on_subscription_price: Filing says allocation between Class A and Class C did not change aggregate subscribed shares, subscription price or per-share price.
sbi_ownership_limitation.interpretation: 39.9% is a voting-ownership limitation, not a 39.9% cash contribution or proof that SBI supplied all Advance Funding cash.

ripple_relationship.classification: In-kind XRP and equity/unit consideration; not cash-funded exchange purchases.

institutional_relationships.sbic_disambiguation: The SEC filing's defined term SBI refers to SBI Holdings, Inc. and its four controlled stockholders listed above. It does not identify the separate Japanese SBIC East, SBIC Central or SBIC West investment companies.

sbi_group_at_closing.source_basis: SEC pro forma capitalization table at closing
sbi_group_at_closing.interpretation: SBI held 21.4% of outstanding Pubco common stock and 39.9% of voting power at closing. These are equity ownership and voting measurements, not a percentage of the $214.05M Advance Funding cash.

sbi_stockholder_positions_as_of_prospect.data_basis: Beneficial ownership before the offering in the SEC prospectus; per-entity positions disclosed in the selling-securityholder table and footnotes.
sbi_stockholder_positions_as_of_prospect.class_c_status: Convertible into Class A under the charter; Class C does not vote except on specified amendments affecting its class rights or ownership restrictions.
sbi_stockholder_positions_as_of_prospect.note: Per-entity Class A/Class C positions are not a disclosure of the dollar amounts subscribed by each SBI affiliate.

pro_forma_capitalization_at_closing.holder_group: Other advance and delayed funding subscribers
